n: 24 Inch 48 Dba Front Control Smart Wi-fi Enabled Dishwasher With Quadwash™
desc: Get a spotless clean every time with LG's 24-inch front-control dishwasher featuring exclusive QuadWash technology. With four spray arms instead of just two, QuadWash uses Multi-Motion arms that rotate back and forth while spinning to power-clean dishes from multiple angles throughout the entire cycle.
hl: Get a Spotless Clean the First Time
LG’s exclusive QuadWash™ technology gets dishes clean the first time.
Beautiful interior with rust-free peace of mind
The NeverRust™ Stainless steel interior tub helps improve drying performance and resists rust for years to come.
Life's better when your home runs smart
Discover ThinQ Care within the ThinQ app -- proactive smart alerts to keep your appliances running smoothly.
